text: Aliens invaded Earth. Read the reviews. And left. The ship landed outside the president's office. Weapons ready. But first, they checked Earth's rating. One point two stars. Too hot. Too loud. Residents keep pressing big red buttons. So they left. But they took one souvenir. Zuckerberg. They thought he was one of them. Two days later, they returned him. Too robotic, even for aliens. Rate Earth out of five. Honestly.
